paragraphs.source_en: The letter's substance was this: by Heaven's grace, England, France, and the Netherlands had maintained relations with Japan for more than ten years and knew well the great renown of His Lordship the shogun; John Saris had therefore been appointed special envoy and sent across the oceans to offer greetings, in the hope of expanding trade, exchanging envoys, and establishing commercial houses in each other's lands.

paragraphs.source_en: This left the Catholic missionaries more frightened than ever. They too had received a military envoy—none other than Commander Vizcaíno, who had come in search of treasure. Their guilty unease made them still more desperate and drove them to take rash action.
